fidelity_limits: No production login, registration submission, account lookup or payment was performed.
The linked registration guide shows a temporary emailed password; current verification questions and authenticated continuation remain unobserved. Do not inherit AVEC SSN/phone verification.
Official paperless documents give different navigation generations; private current navigation needs verification.
Business-day calendar, holidays, cutoff time, settlement, insufficient-funds fees and exact retry behavior remain unspecified.
The source links Google Home voice integration; this is not evidence of Google sign-in.
Public frontend assets are reference material; redistribution rights are unresolved.
Current public first steps are reconstructed; private forms, fixtures, posting and registration continuation are synthetic implementations of documented flows.
Registration uses a declared synthetic current-bill-amount question; temporary passwords expire after 15 minutes and change grants after 5 minutes.
AutoPay rolls Saturday/Sunday to Monday; unobserved holidays are not included.
Savings, Shared Savings credits, usage/outage/service management, statement PDFs and the complete marketing homepage remain unfinished.
The public guest screen displays a reCAPTCHA notice; production challenge solving is not implemented.
Homepage uses a static public capture; search, original scripts, unsupported marketing destinations and uncaptured assets remain unfinished.
implementation_requirements: server-enforced GVP identifiers and no online payment fee
tenant-specific AutoPay day and calendar, explicit synthetic gaps
temporary-password mailbox flow with restricted first-login password change if current source confirms it
Infinity task manifests, private negative predicates and Puppeteer references
